intro: CopilotWatchTower collects Microsoft 365 Copilot activity from multiple sources and analyzes it in one place. Each collection menu differs in the <strongData>data it collects</strongData>, the <strongTech>technology it uses</strongTech>, the <strongPerm>permissions</strongPerm> it needs, and its <strongConstraint>constraints/scope</strongConstraint>. Review each source's characteristics below, then run individual collections from the menu on the left.

authMethod.title: Authentication methods
authMethod.bootstrapDesc: — One time only. Creates an Entra app registration and grants the required permissions via tenant admin consent.
authMethod.appOnlyDesc: — For everyday collection. Calls the Graph API using the issued secret (valid 180 days). Some eDiscovery/Teams/credit paths use delegated or web-automation sign-in.
authMethod.noteDesc: If permissions are insufficient, re-consent to the missing permissions from <1>{{label}}</1>, or create a new profile to regenerate the app with the latest permissions.

api.title: Conversation collection (API)
api.summary: Collects Copilot conversation body text directly per user via the Microsoft Graph API.
api.technology: Microsoft Graph (beta) · getAllEnterpriseInteractions · app-only (client credentials) token
data: App origin (BizChat, Word, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Loop, etc.)
constraints: Only targets users with a Copilot license (all/licensed/group/specific users depending on scope settings)
Body text for unlicensed users is collected separately via the eDiscovery path

ediscovery.title: Conversation collection (e-Discovery)
ediscovery.summary: Restores Copilot body text via Purview eDiscovery, including unlicensed users.
data: Copilot conversation body text including unlicensed users
permissions: The executing account needs the eDiscovery Manager role
constraints: App-only auth is Premium-only, so delegated auth is used
Runs asynchronously: create case → search → estimate → export → download → parse
Supports resuming per stage — can restart after a stop

teams.title: Conversation collection (Teams)
teams.summary: Collects Teams conversation transcripts from Copilot Studio custom agents via Dataverse.
data: Teams conversation history (transcripts) from Copilot Studio custom agents
constraints: Requires per-environment access — environments without it are handled via the 'Add myself as System Administrator' option
Based on browser auto-login, so it is affected by MFA/session policies

agents.title: Agents
agents.summary: Collects agent inventory and real usage signals from the Copilot admin API and audit logs.
agents.technology: Microsoft Graph Copilot admin API (agent registration/catalog) + audit logs
data: Real usage signals based on audit logs
constraints: Usage signals are based on audit logs, so accuracy improves the earlier audit events are collected
Some items may be empty depending on admin API availability (tenant configuration)

consumption.title: Power Platform credits
consumption.summary: Downloads PPAC consumption reports to track message/AI Builder/API request usage.
consumption.technology: Power Platform admin center (PPAC) auto-login · consumption report download
constraints: Based on web automation — depends on PPAC UI/report availability
Only collected within the aggregation period/unit the report provides

audit.title: Audit events
audit.summary: Collects security/access events from the Purview unified audit log and Entra audit/sign-in.
audit.technology: Graph security.auditLog.queries (asynchronous Purview unified log) + Entra audit/sign-in
permissions: Also requires a Purview/Exchange roleManagement role
constraints: Only data within the Purview audit log retention period can be queried
Unified log queries are asynchronous (submit → poll → result)
If the auditLog query returns 404, the Purview path is automatically disabled and only the Entra path is used

usage.title: Official usage
usage.summary: Collects official Microsoft 365 Copilot usage report snapshots.
usage.technology: Microsoft Graph Reports API (Copilot usage CSV)
data: Official M365 Copilot usage report snapshots
constraints: Affected by Microsoft's report anonymization setting — de-anonymize via ReportSettings if user identification is needed
Only collected at the reporting period granularity Microsoft provides
